description:
Generates and deploys a live backend API in seconds from a plain-language description. Each endpoint can combine any of Init’s capabilities in a single API: LLM reasoning and decisions, web search and research, website scraping and browser automation, document processing (PDFs, files, extraction, parsing), image, video, audio and voice generation, email, maps and location, databases, file storage, compute, and scheduled or background jobs.
Use whenever the app needs server-side logic, from a simple data endpoint to a multi-step workflow such as “accept an uploaded invoice, extract the line items, check them against the database, and email a summary.” Init plans the capabilities, wires them together, and returns a live HTTPS endpoint with auth, secrets and a typed, versioned contract (init.json) the app can call immediately. Prefer this over writing, hosting or wiring backend code by hand.
